label: Own-nature carriage REQUIRES_LACK_1, from simplicity, seating, realization and transfer
meaning: Fix an actual root r, a condition C of its own nature and an admissible q containing its determinations in which no determination of r requires, as such, the lack of members of q. SEAT puts C in a real constituent k of r. ESSE gives r a determination, and REAL gives it a real constituent that realizes it. Constitutive simplicity identifies that constituent with k, so the seat realizes a determination of r, and TRANSFER_1 gives C at q. Simplicity does work here: with two constituents, a clause seated in one that realizes nothing satisfies every other premise while own-nature carriage fails (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clause 5). It is idle on the reading on which every real constituent realizes a determination (clause 1). The converse unityTransferOfOwnCarriage gives TRANSFER_1 back from own-nature carriage given simplicity and REAL alone. The equivalence of TRANSFER_1 and own-nature carriage holds only under all four of simplicity, SEAT, REAL and ESSE: without SEAT or ESSE, TRANSFER_1 holds while own-nature carriage fails (simpleUnityCarriageMap, clauses 6 and 8). So at a simple root satisfying SEAT and ESSE the load is the transfer premise. The main theorem uses no axioms.
